choices.content: Add 5 to both sides of the equation.
Multiply both sides of the equation by 5.
Divide both sides of the equation by 5.
Subtract 5 from both sides of the equation.

question.prompt: Which property of equality is used to obtain \(x=4\) from \(x+5=9\)?

solutions.explanation: To eliminate the \(+5\) on the left side, subtract 5 from both sides: \(x+5-5=9-5\), giving \(x=4\).
solutions.title: Subtract 5 from both sides
